sn45.122-126:1.10: the Ganges, Yamunā, Aciravatī, Sarabhū, and Mahī, all of them slant, slope, and incline to the ocean;
sn45.122-126:1.11: In the same way, a mendicant who develops and cultivates the noble eightfold path slants, slopes, and inclines to extinguishment.
sn45.122-126:1.12: And how does a mendicant who develops the noble eightfold path slant, slope, and incline to extinguishment?
sn45.122-126:1.13: It’s when a mendicant develops right view, whose objective, destination, and culmination is freedom from death … develops right concentration, whose objective, destination, and culmination is freedom from death.
sn45.122-126:1.14: That’s how a mendicant who develops and cultivates the noble eightfold path slants, slopes, and inclines to extinguishment.”
